get.summary:
This method retrieves tracking events for the tracking reference returned by a successful call to CreateBooking
the values for status are: confirmed, in_progress, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled, failed
The uuid parameter relates to a valid system user account, it can be requested and will be shared by Cyclone securely
the response DTO shows this status and may also have an arrary of previous tracking events with descriptions and timestamps.

post.summary: Use this method to create a quotation for  a potential booking

Generates one or more shipping labels as a single PDF document.
The request may contain data for a single booking reference/tracking number. The generated PDF will contain one page per package (e.g. "1 of N", "2 of N").
On success, this endpoint returns the PDF directly as `application/pdf`. Clients should treat the response body as binary data and either stream it to a `.pdf` file or open it directly in a PDF viewer.
The tracking number associated with the label is returned in the `X-Tracking-Number` response header.
post.description: Client usage notes: Do not attempt to parse the response as JSON on success. Save the response bytes directly to a file with a `.pdf` extension. Example (C#): ``` var bytes = await response.Content.ReadAsByteArrayAsync(); File.WriteAllBytes("labels.pdf", bytes); ```

200.description: PDF generated successfully. The response body contains the PDF binary data.

400.description:
The request was invalid or label generation failed. The response body contains
a JSON object describing the errors.
